verdict.rationale: The single OCR endpoint documents PDF, PPTX, DOCX and "other document formats" via document_url, and PNG, JPEG/JPG, AVIF and other images via image_url, so a developer can send a mix of formats through one API. The developer still has to choose between document_url and image_url inputs, though, and half of the story's format list is never confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit support for XLSX, HTML and email (EML/MSG); a published full list of supported formats; hands-on evidence of mixed-format ingestion through one call path.
